title: Dinner Lady Fruit Full Mango Passion 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Dinner Lady’s Fruit Full Mango Passion is an exotic fusion of sweet Mango and tangy Passionfruit, delivering a bold and tropical vape bursting with vibrant fruit flavours. The luscious, golden ripeness of Mango provides a smooth and juicy base, while the tart and aromatic notes of Passionfruit add a refreshing contrast, creating a lively and well-balanced blend. Part of the Fruit Full Bar Salts collection, Mango Passion is crafted to replicate the punchy, layered flavours commonly found in disposable vapes. Using a double-concentrated Nic Salt formula, this e-liquid ensures a lasting depth of flavour while maintaining a smooth and satisfying vaping experience. Blended at 50VG/50PG, this e-liquid offers an excellent balance of vapour production and full-bodied taste, making it ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping. The nicotine salt formulation provides a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine satisfaction, making it best suited for use with pod kits and classic vape starter devices. Since 2016, Dinner Lady has been crafting high-quality e-liquids that are now enjoyed in over 80 countries worldwide. Their dedication to premium ingredients and expertly developed blends continues to make them a trusted name in the vaping industry.
